title: Carbon Independent Exam / Validator Execution Map
purpose: One canonical target process for qualifying Carbon's exam and then executing that qualified exam for each candidate.
current_maturity: Target-state orientation only. Carbon is currently in Wave B authoring work. The real validator-to-exam vertical is planned for Wave C1. Burgers v1 remains PRE-LIVE until a measured Validation Dossier qualifies the exact exam.
science_boundary: Science ends after R14 produces the canonical scientific result. R15 is a separate network and economic policy decision and cannot rewrite scientific truth.
independence_chain: Challenge controls what physical population counts
Measurement Contract defines what evidence is measured
Score Pack defines how admissible evidence is combined
Uncertainty Policy defines whether a distinction is resolvable
Scientific Result crosses a hard authority boundary before network or economic policy

layers.title: A. Qualify the exam
layers.summary: Carbon must test and freeze the test before it can use that test to qualify candidates.

steps.title: Define the physics job
steps.input: Physical system, governing problem, inputs, outputs, operating envelope, target population P(x), finite sampling design Q(x), evidence weighting w(x), permitted training support, and candidate interface.
steps.controller: Challenge scientific authority; participants do not define the official claim.
steps.action: Prospectively define one exact, versioned scientific claim while keeping P, Q, and w distinct.
steps.output: Registered Challenge definition.
steps.why: A score has no scientific meaning until Carbon states which physical population the claim covers.
steps.failure_states: Missing population, sampling, evidence, envelope, or interface authority leaves the Challenge PRE-LIVE or BLOCKED.
steps.investor: Write the exam syllabus before seeing contestants.
steps.engineer: Freeze the interface, valid operating domain, sampling design, and evidence semantics.
steps.cfd: Bind geometry and parameters, boundary and initial conditions, regimes, quantities of interest, exclusions, and simulation envelope.
steps.physics_phd: Define the target claim and distinguish target measure, finite experimental design, and evidence measure.
steps.maturity_note: Wave B authors bounded contracts; real scientific values and qualification remain human-owned and PRE-LIVE.

steps.title: Qualify the question generator
steps.input: Challenge, target population P, sampling design Q, procedural generator, and qualification campaign.
steps.controller: Challenge and generator qualification authority; the candidate never controls official cases.
steps.action: Test support, exclusions, strata, boundary coverage, duplicate rates, censoring and failure behavior, replay, and TRAIN/EVAL/STRESS isolation.
steps.output: Qualified case-generation process with limitations and realized-distribution evidence.
steps.why: A generator can emit valid-looking cases while sampling the wrong scientific population.
steps.failure_states: Conformance, replay, coverage, or isolation failure blocks qualification and official use.
steps.investor: Prove the machine writing questions draws from the promised syllabus.
steps.engineer: Validate distributional conformance, not merely input validity.
steps.cfd: Validate the design-of-experiments and operating-condition sampler independently from the solution method.
steps.physics_phd: Demonstrate fidelity to the preregistered sampling design rather than to the PDE solution.
steps.maturity_note: B-03 provides bounded generator engineering evidence; it does not scientifically qualify the generator.

steps.title: Qualify the answer-key process
steps.input: Canonical cases, ReferencePolicy, primary reference implementation, independent witness evidence, and convergence and uncertainty studies.
steps.controller: Registered reference policy and human scientific qualification; solver reputation alone has no truth authority.
steps.action: Determine whether the operational reference is accurate enough inside a bounded envelope to support the distinctions Carbon intends to reward. Burgers v1 proposes periodic Cole–Hopf as primary, challenged by a methodologically independent refined conservative solver.
steps.output: Qualified TruthAsset path with provenance, applicability, uncertainty, identity, and typed failure behavior.
steps.why: Carbon must independently check the answer key before grading candidates.
steps.failure_states: Reference divergence, timeout, disagreement, unavailable evidence, or out-of-envelope use remains a typed reference failure and cannot become candidate failure.
steps.investor: Independently check the answer key before grading anyone.
steps.engineer: A reference becomes authoritative only inside the envelope its evidence supports.
steps.cfd: Use grid and timestep refinement, tolerance sensitivity, conservation, and cross-code, analytic, manufactured-solution, or experimental evidence where appropriate.
steps.physics_phd: Treat the reference as a bounded estimator with characterized error; witness evidence constrains uncertainty rather than voting on truth.
steps.maturity_note: B-04 is bounded engineering only. Reference adequacy and the real Burgers TruthAsset remain unqualified.

steps.title: Qualify measurements and decision resolution
steps.input: Qualified reference, proposed measurements, mandatory gates, stress design, Score Pack, reference and measurement uncertainty, reconstruction variability, and finite-exam variability.
steps.controller: Registered Measurement Contract, Evidence Use Contract, and human scientific qualification.
steps.action: Define measurements, admissibility gates, ranking rules, uncertainty propagation, and the smallest difference the exam can resolve.
steps.output: Measurement Contract, evidence-use rules, Score Pack parameters, mandatory gates, stress definitions, and a resolvable or contested region.
steps.why: Carbon cannot reward differences smaller than the exam's own scientific resolution.
steps.failure_states: Unqualified operators, thresholds, uncertainty, weights, or evidence sufficiency leave the decision unresolved and PRE-LIVE.
steps.investor: Prove how precise the grading system is before assigning grades.
steps.engineer: Thresholds and transforms are evidence-backed frozen configuration, not validator-tunable constants.
steps.cfd: Candidate differences below discretization, interpolation, reference, or test-set uncertainty are not meaningful improvements.
steps.physics_phd: Define estimands, admissibility tests, and decision procedures with qualified uncertainty propagation.
steps.maturity_note: B-05 authoring is current Wave B work; no real thresholds, weights, or scientific qualification are implied.

steps.title: Freeze and approve the exam
steps.input: Qualified Challenge, generator, reference, measurements, uncertainty, security and leakage evidence, Score Pack, and exact implementation identities.
steps.controller: Human scientific and security qualification authorities under the registered activation process.
steps.action: Assemble the measured Validation Dossier and decide whether the exact exam has earned authority.
steps.output: QUALIFIED EXAM or explicit PRE-LIVE / BLOCKED state with missing evidence.
steps.why: Architecture, code, and passing software tests do not demonstrate scientific adequacy.
steps.failure_states: Any missing evidence, identity, approval, security result, or unresolved limitation keeps the exact exam unavailable.
steps.investor: Test the test before it can move money.
steps.engineer: An incomplete qualification package means no authoritative exam.
steps.cfd: The verification and validation package must support the claimed envelope and numerical resolution.
steps.physics_phd: Prospective qualification binds experiment, measurement process, and decision rule to exact identities.
steps.maturity_note: Burgers v1 is PRE-LIVE. A measured Validation Dossier and human decisions are still required.

layers.title: B. Execute the exam
layers.summary: The validator executes frozen authority for one candidate; it does not redefine the physics, answer key, measurements, or scoring ruler.

steps.title: Receive and bind submission
steps.input: Authenticated producer identity, declarative strategy, exact submitted bytes, and Challenge selection.
steps.controller: Submission protocol and authenticated validator intake.
steps.action: Bind producer, Challenge, strategy hash, submission ID, and candidate commitment.
steps.output: Immutable candidate submission identity or typed intake/identity failure.
steps.why: The evaluated method must remain the same submitted method.
steps.failure_states: Authentication, byte identity, schema, or Challenge-binding failure rejects intake without creating scientific evidence.
steps.investor: Seal the contestant's entry before testing it.
steps.engineer: Exact producer and submission identity survives through the receipt.
steps.cfd: Freeze the exact surrogate-development recipe before blind verification.
steps.physics_phd: Establish treatment identity and prohibit post-outcome mutation.
steps.maturity_note: A bounded submission lifecycle exists; authenticated real network intake is planned for later work.

steps.title: Validate and compile method
steps.input: Submitted strategy, Challenge-supported catalog, parameter bounds, permitted training policy, and construction contracts.
steps.controller: Challenge-bound catalog and deterministic compiler.
steps.action: Reject malformed, unsupported, out-of-bounds, unused, silently coerced, or hidden-exam-controlling behavior and compile accepted input into one exact construction plan.
steps.output: ResolvedConstructionPlan or InvalidStrategy.
steps.why: Independent validators need the same interpretation of the same method.
steps.failure_states: Unknown, unused, aliased, silently defaulted, coerced, or clamped input fails closed.
steps.investor: Turn the recipe into one exact set of instructions.
steps.engineer: Eliminate silent defaults, aliases, and coercion.
steps.cfd: Normalize the submitted method into the exact executable workflow being compared.
steps.physics_phd: Canonicalize the declared treatment into a reproducible intervention identity.
steps.maturity_note: Wave B provides bounded compilation contracts; the real validator vertical remains planned for Wave C1.

authority.label: Candidate Assembly and Strategy Compiler Contract

steps.title: Independently rebuild candidate
steps.input: Resolved plan, validator-controlled TRAIN randomness, registered training support, resource budget, and pinned environment.
steps.controller: Validator-controlled reconstruction environment.
steps.action: Train or reconstruct from scratch, separate strategy failure from infrastructure failure, and measure stochastic reconstruction variability when required.
steps.output: Candidate artifact with reconstruction evidence, or typed failure.
steps.why: Carbon evaluates a method's ability to produce a model, not a producer-controlled artifact.
steps.failure_states: Strategy, infrastructure, resource, and indeterminate failures remain distinct; infrastructure failure is not scientific failure.
steps.investor: Carbon rebuilds the contestant's model itself.
steps.engineer: Use a controlled environment, randomness, and compute ceiling.
steps.cfd: Rerun the full surrogate-development procedure instead of accepting vendor-provided validation.
steps.physics_phd: Use producer-independent realization of a stochastic treatment; reconstruction variance is experimental uncertainty.
steps.maturity_note: Real miner training and production reconstruction are not implemented or security-qualified; Wave C1 owns the real vertical.

steps.title: Create protected exam randomness
steps.input: Authorized official entropy plus exact Challenge, generator, scoring, evaluation, domain, and role identities.
steps.controller: Validator-side protected seeding authority.
steps.action: Derive private, role-separated randomness for TRAIN, EVAL, STRESS, and finer purposes.
steps.output: Private exam randomness that is never participant-visible.
steps.why: Learning the physics distribution is legitimate; learning exact future exam realizations is not.
steps.failure_states: Missing authority, identity mismatch, reuse, or disclosure blocks official execution and triggers leakage handling.
steps.investor: Know the subject, not tomorrow's questions.
steps.engineer: No participant-controlled evaluation or stress RNG.
steps.cfd: Keep the physical envelope public while blind verification cases remain fresh.
steps.physics_phd: Use fresh preregistered sampling with treatment-independent outcome-case realization.
steps.maturity_note: Wave A proves bounded seed separation and disclosure constraints, not production entropy or LIVE execution.

steps.title: Generate fresh hidden physics cases
steps.input: Protected EVAL/STRESS randomness, qualified generator, sampling design Q, stress allocation, and Challenge envelope.
steps.controller: Qualified generator executing the Challenge-owned design.
steps.action: Sample strata and parameters, enforce support and exclusions, construct the canonical case, verify invariants, and bind private provenance.
steps.output: Canonical hidden physical case, such as Burgers u0(x).
steps.why: Carbon needs a renewable exam instead of a fixed benchmark dataset.
steps.failure_states: Generator, support, duplicate, censoring, provenance, or sufficiency failure remains typed and cannot silently alter the design.
steps.investor: Write a fresh valid question.
steps.engineer: Deterministic from protected inputs but unpredictable beforehand.
steps.cfd: Produce a blind design-of-experiments realization.
steps.physics_phd: Realize one observation unit under the frozen design.
steps.maturity_note: The bounded Burgers generator is not scientifically qualified; official hidden generation awaits the qualified Wave C1 vertical.

steps.title: Produce qualified reference answer
steps.input: Canonical case, exact ReferencePolicy, qualified primary reference, and registered configuration.
steps.controller: Qualified reference policy and validator-controlled truth execution.
steps.action: Run the authorized reference path; for Burgers, u0(x) to Cole–Hopf to u_ref(x,T). Witness execution remains qualification or audit evidence unless policy requires it at runtime.
steps.output: Qualified TruthAsset realization or typed reference failure.
steps.why: Failed or unavailable truth cannot be converted into candidate failure.
steps.failure_states: Divergence, timeout, disagreement, unavailable truth, or out-of-envelope input produces a typed reference outcome.
steps.investor: Generate the independently checked answer.
steps.engineer: Reference failure and candidate failure remain separate types.
steps.cfd: Run the production reference solver on the identical canonical case under its qualified configuration.
steps.physics_phd: Admit the reference realization only inside registered applicability and uncertainty conditions.
steps.maturity_note: The Burgers reference path remains PRE-LIVE and scientifically unqualified.

steps.title: Run candidate on the same case
steps.input: Reconstructed candidate, identical canonical case, and candidate representation contract.
steps.controller: Validator evaluation runtime; adapters may not change the physical case.
steps.action: Execute candidate inference against the same canonical input used by the reference.
steps.output: Candidate prediction, such as Burgers û(x,T), or typed candidate execution failure.
steps.why: Candidate and reference must answer the identical physical question.
steps.failure_states: Malformed output, runtime failure, non-finite result, or representation mismatch stays a candidate-side typed outcome.
steps.investor: Contestant and answer key solve the same problem.
steps.engineer: Adapters cannot change the underlying case.
steps.cfd: No candidate-specific easier truth path.
steps.physics_phd: Create a paired outcome on the same experimental unit.
steps.maturity_note: Current execution is fixture-bounded; real candidate evaluation is planned for Wave C1 and remains non-LIVE.

steps.title: Compute validator-owned measurements
steps.input: Case, candidate prediction, reference, Measurement Contract, stress label, and measurement configuration.
steps.controller: Validator-owned registered measurement operators.
steps.action: Calculate all official evidence, including applicable finiteness, conservation, energy, bound, field-error, and stress-tail measurements.
steps.output: Authorized measurement vector and evidence-sufficiency state.
steps.why: The producer does not grade itself.
steps.failure_states: Inapplicable, insufficient, non-finite, reference-failed, or measurement-failed evidence cannot silently enter score.
steps.investor: Carbon measures the answer, not the contestant.
steps.engineer: Registered operators map raw tensors into validator-authorized scalar evidence.
steps.cfd: Turn field errors, conservation, quantities of interest, and off-design behavior into V&V observables.
steps.physics_phd: Map paired outcomes into preregistered estimands.
steps.maturity_note: B-05 authors the contract; official measurements and thresholds remain unqualified.

steps.title: Apply mandatory physics gates
steps.input: Gate measurements and frozen gate definitions and thresholds.
steps.controller: Registered admissibility policy; the runtime executes but does not invent thresholds.
steps.action: Test scientific admissibility before ranking.
steps.output: PASS, conclusive scientific failure, or a separate infrastructure, reference, or incomplete-evidence state.
steps.why: Unacceptable physics cannot be compensated by average accuracy.
steps.failure_states: Infrastructure, reference, and insufficient-evidence outcomes never masquerade as physics failure or success.
steps.investor: Some failures are disqualifying regardless of overall grade.
steps.engineer: Admissibility precedes aggregation.
steps.cfd: Conservation or physical-bound failures can reject a surrogate before downstream scoring.
steps.physics_phd: Define the feasible set before evaluating the objective functional.
steps.maturity_note: No production gate threshold is supplied by this map; real values require qualification.

steps.title: Score physics, robustness, and accuracy
steps.input: Qualified soft physics defects, accuracy errors, stress mean and tail metrics, and frozen Score Pack transforms and weights.
steps.controller: Challenge-specific registered Score Pack.
steps.action: Compute physics, robustness, and accuracy components, then the Challenge-local combined score under the frozen aggregation rule.
steps.output: Score vector and combined Challenge-local score.
steps.why: One global mean error can hide physical defects and brittle regimes.
steps.failure_states: Inadmissible or insufficient evidence cannot be rescued by soft score; cross-Challenge comparison is unavailable by default.
steps.investor: Grade several dimensions, not one headline number.
steps.engineer: ScoreEngine executes frozen policy; it does not invent it.
steps.cfd: Global accuracy cannot hide catastrophic steep-gradient or off-design failure.
steps.physics_phd: Use a preregistered functional of qualified estimands; weights are Challenge-specific policy, not universal constants.
steps.maturity_note: The bounded scoring engine is engineering evidence only; no real Score Pack is scientifically qualified.

steps.title: Finalize execution and sign receipt
steps.input: Submission, reconstruction, Challenge, generator, reference, scoring, and environment identities; hidden-exam, prediction, reference, measurement, gate, score, and status commitments.
steps.controller: Validator receipt and evidence-retention protocol.
steps.action: Finalize the private transcript and sign a compact commitment.
steps.output: Signed EvaluationReceipt with retained private evidence.
steps.why: Carbon needs auditability without leaking the hidden exam.
steps.failure_states: Incomplete identities, evidence roots, signatures, or finalization keep the result unauthoritative; signature alone never proves scientific validity.
steps.investor: Create a tamper-evident receipt for the claimed exam.
steps.engineer: Bind exact versions and evidence roots.
steps.cfd: Audit which model, solver, configuration, and measurement produced the result.
steps.physics_phd: Preserve provenance for an experimental realization without mistaking signature for validity.
steps.maturity_note: Canonical signed production receipts and key custody are later, security-sensitive work.

steps.title: Measure scientific variability when required
steps.input: Repeated authorized reconstructions, fresh or common case sets, reference uncertainty, and finite-exam sampling evidence.
steps.controller: Registered scientific uncertainty and decision-resolution policy.
steps.action: Estimate reconstruction variability, reconstruction-by-case interaction, finite-exam variability, and decision or rank stability.
steps.output: Scientific decision interval or contested band.
steps.why: Stochastic training and finite samples can make tiny rank differences meaningless.
steps.failure_states: Insufficient repetitions, dependence errors, unresolved variance, or intervals crossing the decision boundary yield INDETERMINATE or CONTESTED.
steps.investor: Check whether the winner still wins when the experiment is honestly repeated.
steps.engineer: Decision reproducibility matters more than byte-identical learned weights.
steps.cfd: Propagate method-development, solver-reference, and sampling variability into comparison.
steps.physics_phd: Estimate the sampling distribution of the candidate comparison under the registered design.
steps.maturity_note: B-E1 plans this bounded harness; no production decision interval is qualified.

steps.title: Audit validator execution and resolve disagreement
steps.input: Receipt, committed execution identity, audit policy, and secondary validator or re-execution environment.
steps.controller: Independent audit and dispute protocol, separate from the original validator.
steps.action: Verify or re-execute selected evaluations and keep evaluator integrity distinct from scientific variability.
steps.output: Audit agreement or disagreement, quarantine, dispute, or re-execution evidence.
steps.why: A validator is not an unquestionable oracle.
steps.failure_states: Identity mismatch, unverifiable receipt, execution disagreement, or unresolved dispute prevents canonical finalization.
steps.investor: Check the examiner, not only the contestant.
steps.engineer: R12 measures scientific variability; R13 tests evaluator integrity.
steps.cfd: Reproduce the exact numerical and measurement path when validator output is challenged.
steps.physics_phd: Separate uncertainty in the scientific comparison from integrity of the observation mechanism.
steps.maturity_note: Full independent validator audit is planned; current bounded evidence does not establish network qualification.

steps.title: Produce canonical scientific result
steps.input: Valid receipts, admissibility, score, uncertainty or contested interval, and required dispute or audit result.
steps.controller: Registered scientific decision rule.
steps.action: Determine exactly what the qualified evidence supports.
steps.output: Valid Challenge-local scientific result or INDETERMINATE / CONTESTED.
steps.why: Floating-point ordering is not scientific evidence of superiority.
steps.failure_states: Unresolved uncertainty, insufficient evidence, audit dispute, or non-comparability remains explicit and cannot be forced into a winner.
steps.investor: If Carbon cannot tell who won, it says so.
steps.engineer: A numeric score does not automatically imply resolved ranking.
steps.cfd: Separation smaller than validated system resolution stays unresolved.
steps.physics_phd: The qualified decision rule respects the uncertainty region instead of converting every positive delta into superiority.
steps.maturity_note: Canonical real-path result production is planned for Wave C1 and remains unavailable until the exam is qualified.

steps.title: Policy decides whether network action follows
steps.input: Canonical scientific result only; never raw hidden material or an arbitrary score dictionary.
steps.controller: Separately registered network and economic policy outside the scientific judge.
steps.action: Decide whether an eligible resolved result creates a testnet event, later frontier event, later treasury obligation, or no action.
steps.output: Optional typed Carbon policy event or chain intent.
steps.why: Token economics must not determine scientific truth.
steps.failure_states: Ineligible, fixture, stale, indeterminate, contested, identity-unbound, or non-qualified results produce no authorized network action.
steps.investor: First decide what science says, then separately decide what to pay for.
steps.engineer: Scientific modules do not directly write Bittensor weights.
steps.cfd: Reward-policy changes cannot retroactively alter model evaluation.
steps.physics_phd: Keep the scientific estimator and economic utility function in separate authority domains.
steps.maturity_note: This step is future policy. It creates no current testnet, mainnet, frontier, treasury, settlement, weight, or emission authority.
